description: You are a sustainability analyst preparing data for an Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) for a transportation or agricultural commodity process. EPDs require reporting environmental impacts across multiple categories, not just carbon footprint. Using openLCA and the USLCI database at ~/LCA_Imports/uslci_database.zip (LCIA methods at ~/LCA_Imports/lcia_methods.zip), you must: (1) import the database and LCIA methods, (2) select a transport process (e.g., diesel truck transport, rail freight, or barge transport) or agricultural production process (e.g., corn, soybean, or wheat farming) from the USLCI database and build a product system for it, (3) run a comprehensive LCIA calculation covering at least 5 distinct impact categories including Global Warming Potential, Acidification Potential, Eutrophication Potential, Ozone Depletion Potential, and at least one additional category (e.g., Human Health particulates, Smog Formation, or Freshwater Ecotoxicity), and (4) export the complete multi-category LCIA results to ~/LCA_Results/epd_results.csv. The CSV must contain at minimum: impact category name, unit, and calculated numeric value for each of the 5+ categories. This data represents the EPD environmental profile of the product.
